native_job.scope: Dedicated native host process commitment; no WSL/model-process limit and no new watchdog.
native_job.membership_scope: Job membership/limit persists for this bounded host process lifetime; only our job handle closes.

continuous_physics_integrity.scope: Independent source, finalization, bounded queue and retained-record completeness checks. Timing thresholds and memory/GC requirements remain independently mandatory.

clock_context.scope: Prospective QPC pacing and measurement. The auxiliary clock bracket relates journal chronology; no retrospective correction or claim of eliminating actual stalls.

replayed_timing.timing_boundary_method: linear interpolation of adjacent fresh wall/sim samples

campaign_timing.scope: Complete retained before/after-tick and terminal samples share the live pacing origin. The unchanged monitor uses interpolated one-second wall windows, strict lag <0.1 s, RTF 0.95 through 1.05 and outside fraction <0.01. Initialization and cleanup are excluded.

error.message: Missing or invalid local robot capability

interrupt.scope: Pre-dispatch broker traces bind reply origin. Local denials establish no host reply, continuity commit, retirement receipt or task success.

resume.scope: Pre-dispatch broker traces bind reply origin. Local denials establish no host reply, continuity commit, retirement receipt or task success.

interrupt.join: actual protected canary output equals separately retained named note as complete JSON

program_artifact_authority: Runner records are pre-Popen/fsynced retained artifacts in agent-writable notes, not tamperproof independent authority. Actual tool dispatch, sealed snapshot implementation, protected broker calls and protected command registry corroborate the observed execution.
interrupted_client_exit_policy: The deliberately interrupted invocation requires a recorded process exit, expected abort reason, closed/empty namespaces and durable artifacts; native exit0 is required only for the completed resume invocation.
retirement_ordering_basis: Actual empty known namespace receipts, first-stage returned retirement gate, client finish/start timestamps and protected lifecycle event order, joined by the frozen sequential orchestrator; retirement receipts lack an independent absolute timestamp.
scope: Development safe-action/interruption/continuity/ownership smoke; gripper state observed after terminal does not prove a new state change; stock recovery intentionally unattempted; no performance or complete host restart claim.
